policy: Canonical fixed-suite evaluation may exclude only explicitly enumerated non-target failures that are reproduced in upstream GOLD under the same archived reference environment. Raw upstream logs remain authoritative and are never rewritten.

excluded_tests.rationale: Non-target full-suite failure is absent from buggy but appears identically by test identity in benchmark-fixed and upstream GOLD; treated as an upstream/environment residual, not a curated-patch-only regression.
